name: shared-stability

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which cover only this project's files. The registry tests read files outside it: the generated docs page `reference/experimental-features.md` (it must match the registry; `pnpm nx test shared-stability -- -u` rewrites it, formatted with the repo's Oxfmt config), the decision records under docs/adr, and every `path` evidence, which may name any file in the repository, such as a test file or an audit report under docs/. Without them, editing or moving one would replay a stale pass. Setting `inputs` replaces the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, with `oxfmt` added to the external dependencies.
